description: Two sibling pages of server/8.0/xdcr-reference/ name the identical bucket-level conflict-resolution choice differently. xdcr-filtering-reference-intro.md calls the two values 'revision-based' and 'timestamp-based'; xdcr-advanced-settings.md, in the same batch, calls the same fixed-at-creation choice 'sequence number' and 'timestamp'. Both describe one setting whose default is sequence-number-based - a reader moving between the two pages would reasonably wonder whether 'revision-based' and 'sequence-number-based' are the same option or two different ones.
